About Us

Who Is Arya Engineering?

Arya Engineering & Infra India Pvt. Ltd. was founded in 2002. We are a Maharashtra-based construction company focused on building quality infrastructure for government bodies, public authorities, and private developers.

We handle roads, bridges, solar energy projects, smart traffic systems, and large civil works — delivering every project on time and within budget.

From Wardha, we have grown to serve clients across Maharashtra with a team of skilled engineers and a full fleet of modern machinery.

Our Vision

Regional market leader in civil engineering & construction

Our Mission

World-class, affordable, sustainable construction services

Our Values

Professionalism, integrity, creativity & quality delivery

Our Motto

"We Build Tomorrow" — every project, every time

What We Do

Our Core Services

Get a Quote →
🏗️

Civil Engineering & Roads

We build national, state and rural roads. From gravel paths to full bitumen highways — drainage, steel structures and reinforced concrete included.
☀️

Renewable Energy & Solar EPC

Full solar project services — from design and buying equipment to building and long-term maintenance — for factories, businesses and government sites.
🌉

Bridge Construction

RCC bridges, flyovers and culverts built using modern methods to ensure strength and long life across Maharashtra.
🚦

ITMS / ATMS Solutions

Smart traffic management systems — full design, planning, setup and system connection for government and highway projects.
🏢

Commercial Infrastructure

Industrial sheds, commercial buildings and large earthworks — digging, land clearing and foundation work for all scales.
⛏️

Mining & Equipment Rental

Mining work plus a large fleet of modern heavy machines available for rent — excavators, cranes, dumpers and more.
